Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy: ECG finding: ST-segment elevation in leads V2–V6
hypokinesis of the basal and mid segments of the LV
absence of major atherosclerotic lesions or coronary spasm

top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient presented with sudden onset of substernal chest pain and ECG findings of ST-segment elevation in leads V2–V6, which are consistent with the diagnosis of Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy. The echocardiographic evaluation also showed decreased LV ejection fraction and new regional wall motion abnormalities, which further supports this diagnosis. Additionally, the absence of major atherosclerotic lesions or coronary spasm, as well as the presence of an emotional or physical stress trigger, are also consistent with Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy.
